jobs.description:
The client is a well-established international premium fashion brand, renowned for its timeless style, exceptional craftsmanship, and strong commitment to quality. Combining heritage with innovation, the company offers sophisticated collections that inspire customers worldwide and delivers a premium retail experience across its stores and digital channels.

Jobomschrijving

As Retail Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the performance of multiple stores, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering outstanding commercial results. Acting as a true brand ambassador, you will play a key role in translating business strategy into action on the shop floor.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive sales growth and profitability across your store portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Sr KAM Off Trade - Non food company

Known for its strong brands, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to sustainability, it combines global scale with local market expertise. The organization places a strong emphasis on quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement, making it a dynamic and forward-thinking environment within the fast-moving consumer goods industry.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior KAM, you will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of key retail accounts, developing tailored commercial strategies to drive distribution, visibility, and long-term profitable growth. You will act as the primary point of contact for your customers, ensuring strong partnerships and flawless execution in the market.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and develop strategic relationships with key off-trade customers in the non-food channel.
• Negotiate annual agreements, pricing, and promotional plans to deliver sustainable growth.
• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned with customer and company objectives.
• Drive distribution, shelf presence, and visibility of product ranges across retail partners.
• Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer performance to identify opportunities.
• Collaborate closely with marketing, supply chain, and category teams to ensure execution excellence.
• Deliver against sales, profitability, and market share targets.
• Provide regular performance analysis and strategic recommendations to senior management.

• Proven experience in Key Account Management within FMCG, preferably in non-food or general merchandise.
• Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation skills.
• Ability to build long-term, trust-based relationships with retail partners.
• Analytical mindset with strong understanding of sales data and category performance.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented approach.
• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English.

The company is a fast-growing food retail chain known for offering high-quality, fresh, and convenient food options at accessible prices. With a strong focus on customer experience, operational efficiency, and product consistency, it operates a network of locations designed to serve customers on-the-go while maintaining strong brand standards and a welcoming atmosphere.

• Collaborate with Head Office teams on promotions, merchandising, and business initiatives.
• Identify local market opportunities to drive growth and customer loyalty.
• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and food hygiene regulations.

• Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop teams at scale.
• Commercially minded with a strong focus on KPIs and results.
• Hands-on, pragmatic, and comfortable in a fast-moving environment.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Passion for food, customer experience, and operational excellence.
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in the Brabant Wallon
jobs.description:

• Manage the full accounting cycle for several entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.
• Handle daily accounting operations, including purchase invoices, bank transactions, payments, reconciliations, and journal entries.
• Prepare monthly and year-end closings, provisions, accruals, and supporting financial analyses.
• Ensure timely VAT, Intrastat, and statutory reporting obligations are met.
• Prepare annual accounts and support audit activities in collaboration with the Chief Accountant.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes and support ad hoc finance projects.

• Holds a degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent professional experience.
• Speaks fluent French and Dutch ; English is a great asset.
• Has solid end-to-end accounting experience and is comfortable managing entities autonomously.
• Has a strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, VAT, and statutory obligations.
• Is structured, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
